description: Can you get OUT of a $size position, and at what slippage? Not binary 'sellable' — size-aware exit-liquidity. A token can be sellable yet trap you (thin pool: exiting $5k costs 20%+). Returns exit_slippage_pct for your size, max exit under 5%/10% slippage, liquidity, thin-volume warning, verdict = EASY_EXIT/MODERATE/THIN/TRAP/NO_EXIT. Call BEFORE entering to size the position to your real exit capacity. RH-chain (0x) or Solana (base58).
name: exit_check
